pairfree.description: PairFree is a lightweight, open-source Android app that brings your wireless earbuds and headphones together in one place, so you don't have to install a separate app for every brand. It aims to replace bulky companion apps with a simpler, faster alternative that connects directly to your devices over Bluetooth. With support for brands like SOUNDPEATS, Soundcore, Samsung Galaxy Buds, Sony, Bose, JBL, AirPods, Beats, Nothing, CMF, Pixel Buds, QCY, and 1MORE, you can adjust noise cancellation, transparency mode, EQ settings, touch controls, check battery levels, and more, depending on your device. Everything works without an account or internet connection, and there are no ads or trackers. Device compatibility and available features vary by model, with support continuing to expand.
